Catalog descriptions, periods, terms and distribution links checked against captured metadata; no new publisher downloads or answer reruns. Review is relative to saved evidence, not independent domain certification or a security audit. Prior review was by Claude Opus 5.5, a different model family from both Astra and the GPT-6.1 Sol answer model.
